profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Experienced algorithm designer, software architect, applied mathematician, and devops practicioner.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architect, design, and implement scalable and secure software solutions for cloud media and infrastructure. Supporting the Azure Storage, Media, and Edge team. 

- Distributed computing, leveraging cloud resources
- High-availability, system reliability

positions.title: Senior GNC Engineer
positions.description:
· Develop flight software and high fidelity computer simulations for flight vehicles. Design and implement novel algorithms.
· Advise teams of young engineers on multiple programs in approaching technical challenges.
· Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on control and guidance of endo- and exoatmospheric flight vehicles.

positions.title: GNC Team Lead
positions.description:
· Manage a small, agile team of GNC engineers and software developers
· Set expectations, deliver tasking, drive schedule and provide feedback to team members
· Develop, improve, and maintain two large, legacy ESW and simulation codebases (C/C++, 1.5 million+ SLOC)

positions.title: Guidance, Navigation, and Control Engineer
positions.description:
· Design, develop, verify and validate algorithms used in flight control and guidance of missiles
· Produce, refine and maintain simulation tools associated with flight performance and estimation of parameters

positions.title: Responsible Engineering Authority
positions.description:
· Production hardware REA for the SM-3 Block IA/IB program
· Directly support guidance section factory, including daily troubleshooting and disposition of production hardware
· Interface program engineering, factory personnel, engineering disciplines (reliability, systems, quality, etc), to drive critical tasks and
deliver hardware.

positions.title: Adjunct Faculty
positions.description: Develop a working relationship with 30-50 young men and women. Develop and improve curriculum, deliver weekly lectures and assignments, create and administer examinations, assign final grades.

positions.title: Chief Engineer
positions.description:
· Design of pneumatically and electrically actuated fluid control valves.
· Manufacturing engineering and project management, including scheduling, detail drawing production, change management, assembly and
test coordination.

positions.title: Machinist/Technician
positions.description:
Setup and operation of manual machine tools, including engine lathes, knee mills, surface grinders, hones, drill presses and band saws.
Tool making, tool maintenance, including turning/form tool grinding and drill sharpening.
Programming, setup, and operation of CNC lathes.

publications.title: Quaternion State Estimation
publications.publisher: International Journal of Engineering Sciences and Management · Jun 1, 2014
